import numpy as np
# (1) verify F_chi'(x_n,x_{n+1}) = chi'(2)^{-b_n} identity on a sample orbit, c=5
c=5; Q=3**c; PHI=2*3**(c-1)
dlog={}; p=1
for j in range(PHI): dlog[p]=j; p=(p*2)%Q
def chi(k,x): return np.exp(2j*np.pi*k*dlog[x%Q if x%Q in dlog else None]/PHI) if (x%Q)%3 else None
x=27; ok=0; n=0
for step in range(2000):
    y=3*x+1; b=0
    while y%2==0: y//=2; b+=1
    k=7  # a primitive character index
    F=np.exp(2j*np.pi*k*dlog[y%Q]/PHI)*np.exp(-2j*np.pi*k*dlog[(3*x+1)%Q]/PHI) if ((3*x+1)%Q)%3 else None
    rhs=np.exp(-2j*np.pi*k*dlog[2]*b/PHI)
    if F is not None:
        n+=1
        if abs(F-rhs)<1e-12: ok+=1
    x=y
print(f"identity F_chi'(x,Sx) = chi'(2)^-b: {ok}/{n} exact")
# (2) letter-mean along trajectories: typical (should -> 2) vs the known x=1 cycle (=2)
import random
random.seed(1)
means=[]
for trial in range(200):
    x=random.randrange(10**8,10**9)*2+1
    B=0;N=0
    while x!=1 and N<5000:
        y=3*x+1; b=0
        while y%2==0: y//=2; b+=1
        B+=b; N+=1; x=y
    means.append(B/N)
print(f"typical orbit letter-mean: {np.mean(means):.4f} +- {np.std(means):.4f}  (stationary 2; drift threshold log2(3)={np.log2(3):.4f})")
